definitions.explanation: The sound of many cicadas singing at once, likened to a passing shower of rain. A literary word and a haiku season word for summer.

examples.japanese: {蝉時雨|せみしぐれ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: To walk amid the chorus of cicadas.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{境内|けいだい}→境内：12095_keidai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{蝉時雨|せみしぐれ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{包|つつ}まれていた→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧。
examples.english: The temple grounds were wrapped in the chorus of cicadas.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧、⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{降|ふ}り{注|そそ}ぐ→降り注ぐ：07976_furisosogu⟧ような{蝉時雨|せみしぐれ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いていた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: On a summer afternoon, the cicadas' chorus poured down endlessly in the woods.

notes:
From {蝉|せみ} (cicada) + ⟦{時雨|しぐれ}→時雨：30753_shigure⟧ (a passing late-autumn shower). Common in novels, essays and haiku; in conversation people say ⟦セミ→セミ：09931_semi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}いている→鳴く：04388_naku⟧.
